description: a young woman marksman with long black hair and a silver circlet, dark leather armour with a silver pauldron, a long green cloak, a quiver of white-fletched arrows on her back, brown boots, a long black bow in her right hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
